fails_if: `prepare_source_values` (prepared_values.py) wraps a SourceFormatError as PreparedValueError, so `prepare-sources` reports the SCB value-shape refusal as source_preparation_failed instead of its own scb_value_shape_unsupported
note: The reachable SCB value-file refusal: one Vardemangder row whose version, level and code are the same unknown marker `New marker` (the input of cases/prepare/scb-values-unknown-type-marker-refused, which pins the code at the reader). The sibling case pins the same pass-through for scb_native_id_invalid; this one pins it for a refusal raised while the value files are prepared, which the generic wrap used to hide. The empty --curation-dir keeps the committed curation tree out of the case.
